name: loika-v4-adult-patches
refs: THE SHEET TO EDIT: six poses of one dark charcoal creature (the Loika, adult) on flat magenta, in a 3 by 2 grid. Keep it exactly; only add what is asked.

The accepted Pip marked/plain pair (project-owned): on the left the plain creature, on the right the same creature marked. Take ONLY the SHAPE and MANNER of the pale cream patches on the right one: a broad curving patch behind the shoulder bowing down the flank, and smaller oval patches over the haunch, in the soft cream of its belly, shaded by the fur. Ignore its leaf crown, its glow and its dark background entirely.
prompt: Edit the first reference. Paint pale cream PATCHES on the dark coat of every one of the six creatures: the same patch shapes as on the marked creature in the second reference, carried onto each pose so they follow that pose's body (a broad curving patch behind the shoulder bowing down the flank, with smaller oval patches over the haunch and the back), pale cream like its belly, with the fur's soft shading and the light from the top left over them. Patches go only on the dark fur of the body: none on the head, face, eye rings, belly cream, toes or legs below the thigh. In the closed-eye and curled poses the patches follow the visible body. Return the SAME sheet: every creature in exactly the same position, pose, size, outline, silhouette, eyes, belly cream, toes, shadow and light (soft light from the top left) and the same flat magenta (#FF00FF) ground; no new object, no text, no labels, no borders, no glow, no leaves, no crest, no hands, no people.
